app.title: VaultDrop
app.description: No sign-up, no storage, no limits. Data streams directly between two devices.

dropzone.title: Drag and drop your file here
dropzone.subtitle: or click to select from your device
dropzone.subtitle_mobile: Tap to select photos, videos, or documents
dropzone.hint: All file formats supported • 10 GB+ stream support
dropzone.hint_mobile: No size limits • 10 GB+ stream support

share.title: Share Link
share.description: Share this link with the receiver. The encryption key resides strictly in the link and is never sent to the server.

fallback.title: P2P Connection Failed
fallback.description: Direct peer connection could not be established. You can continue the transfer via an encrypted Cloudflare tunnel.
fallback.security: Your file is encrypted locally in your browser. Cloudflare cannot decrypt or inspect file contents.
fallback.metadata: In tunnel mode, Cloudflare can observe client IP addresses and transfer timestamps.

receive.title: Receiving File
receive.sender_preparing: Sender is encrypting and preparing file stream...
receive.incoming_desc: The sender wants to share this file with you.
receive.e2ee_note: This file is encrypted on the sender device and streams directly to you. Never stored on any server.
receive.rejected_by_receiver: The receiver declined the file transfer.

errors.roomFull: Room is full — only 2 people can connect at a time.
errors.transferRejected: The receiver declined the file transfer.
errors.hashMismatch: File integrity check failed! The file may have been corrupted in transit.
errors.browserNotSupported: Your browser does not support this feature.
errors.fileTooLarge: File size is too large for this browser.

pwa.update_desc: A new version of VaultDrop is available. Reload to update.

history.title: Transfer History
history.saving_disabled_hint: History recording is disabled. Future transfers will not be stored in IndexedDB.
history.empty_desc: Your file transfers are never sent to a server; they are only listed locally within your browser.
history.privacy_note: All transfer records are saved locally in this device's IndexedDB. Zero logs on the server.

mobile_receive.action_desc: Scan sender's QR code to receive directly on this device

qr_scanner.title: Scan QR Code
qr_scanner.align_frame: Align QR code within the frame
qr_scanner.camera_error: Could not access camera or permission denied.
qr_scanner.permission_hint: Please allow camera permissions in your browser settings.
qr_scanner.invalid_qr: Not a valid VaultDrop transfer QR code.
